title: The merge lock's TTL waits (WAITS=3, merge.py ~3214) no longer block up to 250 minutes after a crash
why: A crashed holder can block the next merge for up to 250 min (debt lock-ttl-sized-for-gone-waits; consultant's figure, unmeasured by triage).
source: Consultant 20:59 CST Nov 13, from its Opus read-only audit of merge/merge.py at origin/main 309fa5ed5b; line numbers and debts are its, unchecked by triage.
note: Triage 21:00 CST Nov 13: red case first: a lock whose holder is gone frees within a bound the record states.
